assistant.title: Three modes
assistant.text: Ask about past runs, draft a workflow, or draft safety limits and rules.

assistant.title: You decide
assistant.text: A draft is only a proposal until you accept it.

assistant.title: Describe it
assistant.text: In your own words. The draft is checked against this deck’s real methods.

cloud-connect.title: Device name
cloud-connect.text: How this deck is listed in Cloud. You can change it when you approve.

cloud-connect.title: Connect
cloud-connect.text: Shows a code. Enter it in Cloud to approve this deck.

data-history-list.title: Search
data-history-list.text: By name, a value, an instrument or a method. Select deletes several at once.

data-history-list.title: Sort and filter
data-history-list.text: Newest, oldest, by name or length, and by status.

data-history-list.title: A run
data-history-list.text: Green finished, amber finished with issues, red failed. Click to open it.

data-history-optimization.title: Configuration
data-history-optimization.text: The engine, the budget, the search space and the objectives the run used.

data-history-optimization.title: Optimizer plots
data-history-optimization.text: Drawn by the optimizer itself, for the latest optimization since the deck started.

data-history-run.title: Timeline
data-history-run.text: One bar per step, to scale. Prep, each sample and cleanup are marked above.

data-history-run.title: Data
data-history-run.text: One row per sample: the values it was given, then the values its steps saved.

data-history-run.title: Export
data-history-run.text: Data is this table as CSV. Log is every step.

data-history-steps.title: Prep and cleanup
data-history-steps.text: Each ran once. Click a line to open its steps.

data-history-steps.title: From a #variable
data-history-steps.text: A coloured value came from the run’s inputs.

data-history-steps.title: What a step saved
data-history-steps.text: The result, under the name the workflow gave it.

data-history-trials.title: One row per trial
data-history-trials.text: What the optimizer suggested, then the objectives the trial measured.

designer-batch.title: Once per batch
designer-batch.text: Click the layers icon. Purple means the step runs once for a group of rows, not for each.

designer-empty.title: Toolbox
designer-empty.text: Everything this deck can do. Each instrument method is one step.

designer-empty.title: Canvas
designer-empty.text: Drag a step here. Steps run top to bottom.

designer-empty.title: #auto
designer-empty.text: On: a dropped step leaves every value open, to fill in at run time.

designer-file-menu.title: More
designer-file-menu.text: Read the workflow as Python, or move it as a JSON file.

designer-header.title: Name
designer-header.text: How the workflow is saved and found.

designer-header.title: Save
designer-header.text: Adds a version to the Library.

designer-header.title: More
designer-header.text: View as Python, export or import JSON.

designer-links.title: Link
designer-links.text: With Link on, a saved workflow dragged in stays one step.

designer-links.title: A linked workflow
designer-links.text: One step, pinned to the saved version. Its open values are the step’s inputs.

designer-links.title: View or detach
designer-links.text: See the steps it will run, or turn it into steps of your own.

designer-logic.title: Logic steps
designer-logic.text: Wait, ask a person, set a variable, branch, loop, write a note.

designer-logic.title: If
designer-logic.text: The steps down to End if run only when the condition holds.

designer-logic.title: Copy or link
designer-logic.text: Drag a saved workflow in as your own steps, or as one step that follows the original.

designer-overview.title: Toolbox
designer-overview.text: Logic steps, saved workflows, then every method of every instrument.

designer-overview.title: Phases
designer-overview.text: Prep runs once first, Main for every sample, Cleanup once last.

designer-overview.title: A step
designer-overview.text: One line that reads like its call: instrument, method, arguments.

designer-overview.title: Run it
designer-overview.text: Configure asks for the open values. Optimize lets an optimizer choose them.

designer-prep.title: Prep
designer-prep.text: Runs once, before the first sample: prime the pumps, blank the spectrometer.

designer-prep.title: Cleanup
designer-prep.text: Runs once, after the last sample. Hold a dragged step over a tab to move it there.

designer-python.title: The script
designer-python.text: Prep, main and cleanup as functions. It follows the canvas as you edit.

designer-step.title: A value
designer-step.text: Type it, or type #name to leave it open for the run.

designer-step.title: Batch, more, delete
designer-step.text: Run once per batch, disable or duplicate, or remove.

first-data.title: The result
first-data.text: The value you gave, and the temperature the step read back.

first-drag.title: Find a step
first-drag.text: Type part of its name. Here: load vial, on the reactor.

first-drag.title: Drop it on the canvas
first-drag.text: Hold the step, carry it over, let go.

first-result.title: Save what it returns
first-result.text: Type a name after the arrow. The reading is kept under it.

first-run.title: Once
first-run.text: One run, one value. The other tabs take a table or an optimizer.

first-run.title: Give the value
first-run.text: The one thing you left open.

first-run.title: Run
first-run.text: The reactor heats. The bar at the bottom follows it.

first-save.title: Save
first-save.text: It is now in the Library.

first-save.title: Configure
first-save.text: Opens the Run page, to give temperature_c a value.

first-variable.title: Leave a value open
first-variable.text: Type #temperature_c instead of a number. You give the number when you run.

instruments.title: Instruments
instruments.text: Everything on the deck, each with its number of methods.

instruments.title: Execute
instruments.text: Fill in the fields and run the method now, outside the queue.

instruments.title: Limit
instruments.text: Set the range this field may take, or its unit.

instruments.title: Restart and deck version
instruments.text: Restart reloads the drivers. The version changes when the instruments do.

instruments-execute.title: Action log
instruments-execute.text: Each call you make here, with what it returned or the error it raised.

library.title: Tags
library.text: Add any number. Chips above the list filter by them.

library.title: Version history
library.text: Every save is kept. Open any of them in the Designer.

library.title: Load to Designer
library.text: Puts the workflow on the canvas to edit or run.

library.title: Working first
library.text: Workflows this deck can no longer run go last, with a badge.

library-tags.title: Add a tag
library-tags.text: Any word. A workflow can carry several.

library-tags.title: Save
library-tags.text: Tags are labels only: no new version is made.

library-versions.title: Current
library-versions.text: The version Load to Designer opens and a new link is pinned to.

library-versions.title: Open an older one
library-versions.text: It loads into the Designer. Save there to make it the newest.

live-run.title: What it is doing
live-run.text: The run’s name, the step it is on, and how far along.

live-run.title: Pause
live-run.text: After the current step. The same button resumes.

live-run.title: Stop
live-run.text: The flag finishes this sample first. The square stops now, without cleanup.

live-run.title: Queue and steps
live-run.text: What waits behind this run, and every step with its result.

live-run-iterate.title: Sample by sample
live-run-iterate.text: The badge says which sample the run is on. Each row runs the whole of Main.

live-run-iterate.title: Change what is left
live-run-iterate.text: Edit, add or remove samples the run has not reached.

live-run-optimize.title: Trial by trial
live-run-optimize.text: Green trials are done. Each one runs the whole of Main with new values.

live-run-optimize.title: Change budget
live-run-optimize.text: Add trials or end sooner while it runs.

live-run-steps.title: Running now
live-run-steps.text: Finished steps are ticked. The list follows the step in progress.

live-run-steps.title: Change a step
live-run-steps.text: Edit the values of a step that has not run yet.

live-run-steps.title: Resize
live-run-steps.text: Drag to make the list taller. Double-click to reset.

queue-drawer.title: Now
queue-drawer.text: The run under way. The deck runs one at a time.

queue-drawer.title: Up next
queue-drawer.text: What waits, in order. Rename it, change its values, move it sooner or later, or remove it.

run-decision.title: What went wrong
run-decision.text: The step and its error. The run and the queue wait for you.

run-decision.title: Change and retry
run-decision.text: Correct the step’s values, then run it again.

run-decision.title: Retry or skip
run-decision.text: Run the step again as it is, or go on without it.

run-decision.title: Stop
run-decision.text: With cleanup first, or at once, leaving the deck as it is.

run-iterate.title: One column per #variable
run-iterate.text: With the type the driver expects under its name.

run-iterate.title: One row per sample
run-iterate.text: Rows run top to bottom. A row left empty is not a sample.

run-iterate.title: CSV in and out
run-iterate.text: Bring samples from a spreadsheet, or save these.

run-iterate.title: Batch size
run-iterate.text: How many rows share one once-per-batch step. 1 runs each row start to finish.

run-iterate-batch.title: Once per batch
run-iterate-batch.text: This column feeds a batch step: one value for each group.

run-iterate-batch.title: Groups
run-iterate-batch.text: A purple line starts each group of rows.

run-iterate-batch.title: First row counts
run-iterate-batch.text: Greyed cells are ignored: the group takes its first row’s value.

run-once.title: Ways to run
run-once.text: Once is one sample. Iterate is a table of them. Optimize lets an optimizer choose.

run-once.title: One field per #variable
run-once.text: Typed as the driver declares it. An empty field offers None or the driver’s default.

run-once.title: Preview
run-once.text: Every call this run will make, before anything moves.

run-once.title: Run
run-once.text: Starts now. Reads Add to queue while another run is going.

run-once-guard-hint.title: Marked as you type
run-once-guard-hint.text: A value past its limit turns red and says why.

run-once-guard-hint.title: The limit
run-once-guard-hint.text: Shown under the field, in its unit.

run-once-guard-hint.title: Pick a position
run-once-guard-hint.text: A field limited to a tray opens the tray to choose from.

run-optimize.title: Engine
run-optimize.text: The optimizer that suggests each trial.

run-optimize.title: Budget and batch
run-optimize.text: How many trials in all, and how many are suggested at a time.

run-optimize.title: Search space
run-optimize.text: A range, a list of choices, or a fixed value for each #variable.

run-optimize-objectives.title: Objective
run-optimize-objectives.text: Any number a step saves. Maximize or minimize it.

run-optimize-objectives.title: Stop early
run-optimize-objectives.text: End the campaign once a trial reaches this value.

run-optimize-objectives.title: Existing data
run-optimize-objectives.text: Start from earlier runs or a CSV instead of from nothing.

run-optimize-start.title: Start
run-optimize-start.text: Prep runs once, then one trial after another until the budget is used.

run-optimize-start.title: Suggest only
run-optimize-start.text: Get suggestions to run by hand, and enter the results yourself.

run-preview.title: What will run
run-preview.text: Linked workflows are expanded: this is exactly what is queued.

run-preview.title: Prep, once
run-preview.text: Before the first sample. Cleanup, at the end, also runs once.

run-preview.title: Per sample
run-preview.text: Main steps repeat for every row. A batch step shows ×1 per batch.

run-refused.title: Refused before anything moves
run-refused.text: The message names the step, the value and the limit it broke.

run-stages.title: A stage
run-stages.text: Each linked workflow is one. Its line says whether it is ready.

run-stages.title: How it runs
run-stages.text: Pick one and it opens in place: a form, a table, or an optimizer.

run-stages.title: Run
run-stages.text: Offered once every stage is ready. Each is queued as its own run, in order.

safety-limits.title: Four kinds of guard
safety-limits.text: Limits on a field, trays of positions, deck states, and rules between instruments.

safety-limits.title: A limit
safety-limits.text: The lowest and highest value this field may take, and the unit its numbers are in.

safety-limits.title: Per instrument
safety-limits.text: The number is how many limits it has.

safety-limits.title: Save
safety-limits.text: Nothing changes until you save. Then it holds for every run and every manual call.

safety-rules.title: When
safety-rules.text: The call the rule watches for.

safety-rules.title: Require
safety-rules.text: What must hold at that moment. A reading is taken from the instrument right then.

safety-rules.title: Otherwise
safety-rules.text: The call is blocked and the person is told this.

safety-states.title: A state
safety-states.text: A condition of the deck, in your lab’s own words.

safety-states.title: How it is known
safety-states.text: From the calls that change it, or by asking an instrument each time.

safety-states.title: A call that changes it
safety-states.text: After reactor.load_vial the state is loaded.

safety-states.title: Now
safety-states.text: Its value at this moment. Set it by hand if it is unknown.

safety-trays.title: Add a tray
safety-trays.text: Start from a common plate or rack, or set your own size.

safety-trays.title: Size and naming
safety-trays.text: Rows, columns, and how its positions are written: A1, A01 or numbers.

safety-trays.title: Blocked position
safety-trays.text: Click a position to block it. It stays on the tray but may not be used.

safety-trays.title: Where it is used
safety-trays.text: The field that only takes this tray’s positions.

settings.title: Theme
settings.text: Light, dark, or whatever the computer uses.

settings.title: Navigation
settings.text: Pages down the left, or along the top as in the desktop app.

settings.title: Notifications
settings.text: Tell me when a run waits for input or a step fails.

user-input-prompt.title: The step’s message
user-input-prompt.text: Shown on whichever page you are on. The run waits.

user-input-prompt.title: Answer and continue
user-input-prompt.text: The answer is saved under the step’s variable name for later steps.
